source_domain.description: The account this app is installed in, e.g. yora.freshservice.com

source_api_key.description: Used to add notes and sync status back onto tickets in this account

target_domain.description: Where urgent tickets are escalated, e.g. fwddeployhelpdesk.freshservice.com

requester_email.description: Escalated tickets are raised in the target as this requester

target_group_id.description: Optional agent group in the target for escalated tickets

target_custom_fields.description: Fields the target requires on new tickets, e.g. {"msf_multi_agent_groups":[4]}

webhook_token.description: Long random string; the target's Workflow Automator sends it in the X-Bridge-Token header
